subsequently digested with lysyl endopeptidase (Lys-C), sequencing grade modified trypsin and chymotrypsin
Peptide samples were separated by reversed-phase HPLC
methionine oxidation was set as dynamic modification
Samples were subjected to C18 purification and HRM calibration peptides (Biognosys AG) added prior to mass spectrometric analysis.
